interpretation: Exploratory validation-only comparison of training sources, not a new independent test and not a causal estimate of annotation quality.
selection: For both arms use AISSLab validation macro hit within10mm across levels, then lower cross-entropy. Epoch0 positional prior eligible. RSNA validation is scored only after all six models are sealed.
architecture: Unchanged v6 SliceLocalizer; frozen original ImageNet features. Fit mean/std and position prior using each arm TRAIN only.
training: Unchanged v6 domain-balanced cross-entropy, AdamW, batch8, learning_rate0.0003, weight_decay0.0001, max15 epochs, patience4. No grades, AP, sagittal images or TEST.
center: Reuse the exact sealed v6 AISSLab-XML-trained center state for all six models. No center fitting here.
severity: No severity fitting or evaluation in this localization-only comparison.
ensemble: Arithmetic mean slice probabilities of all three prespecified seeds per arm. No seed selection.
evaluation: Same validation patients, per-domain and per-level hit5/hit10, distance, missing references and failures. Paired patient bootstrap of ensemble hit10 difference. Descriptive v6 reference has a different epoch selection criterion.
